title: Security Checks
meta: A review of staff accounts, apps and permissions with the gaps closed, so your store is harder to break into. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Security checks for staff, apps and permissions
overview: Most store break-ins start with a weak password, a former employee who still has access or an app with more rights than it needs. We review who can log in to your store, what each staff account and app can do, and how your admin, email and payment accounts are protected. We close the gaps we can, such as extra access and missing two-step login, and give you a clear list for those that only you can change.

faq: Do you need my passwords to check security?
Never. You add us as staff or collaborator with limited access, and we remove ourselves when finished. We cannot see your passwords, and we will not ask for them.
Can you promise my store cannot be hacked?
No one can promise that. We lower the common risks, such as shared logins and old access, and we give you a plain list of habits that keep the store safer.
Will you find and remove malware?
At Premium level we scan your theme and plugins for suspicious code. If a store is already infected, we tell you what we find and quote the clean-up separately.
Will this lock out my own team?
Only if you ask. We list the changes first, and we remove access only after you approve each one.
